briefdescription.para: Manages voice session lifecycle with immutable state machine.

sect2.title: Lifecycle Overview
sect2.para:
VoiceSessionManager orchestrates the complete session lifecycle:
Creation: new sessions transition to ACTIVE state
Activity tracking: last_activity_ms updated on touchSession()
Expiration: automated cleanup via expireOldSessions()
Termination: explicit or implicit state transitions remove the session from active storage fail-closed

listitem.para: All public methods acquire internal mutex_
Session data snapshots are returned by value (copy-safe)
Maximum concurrent sessions: 1000 per manager instance
